temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual; when Jose asks, she says it is personal and thanks him for asking, but does not share details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is usually vibrant at work, and Jose has no specific reason to think something is seriously wrong.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Jose moves from no specific concern to suspecting Patricia is dealing with a personal problem, though she is not ready to discuss it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia likely has a personal issue troubling her, and she may appreciate support but values her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to listen and be available without pressuring her to share.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worrying about bills and financial commitments; later she admits she feels overwhelmed by bills and is open to discussing financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appears to have a personal problem, but Jose does not know its nature.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Jose now identifies financial stress as a likely major issue and learns Patricia may accept practical help with budgeting.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is under financial strain and is open to discussing financial planning or budgeting support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to help her review budgeting or financial planning when she feels up to it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose worries he may have overstepped by raising financial planning; Patricia reassures him that she did not think he was prying and says she is grateful for his offer.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is financially stressed and may welcome his help, but he is unsure whether his offer felt intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—his worry about overstepping is relieved; Patricia confirms she appreciates his support and does not see it as prying.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: His support is welcome and not intrusive; he can remain a supportive friend while respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worry shifting to relief and gratitude
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue offering respectful support without crossing boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a casual check-in, Patricia gives a brief, positive response and makes small talk without sharing details; Jose senses she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his support and does not think he overstepped, so he believes he can support her as a friend while respecting privacy.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Jose shifts from thinking active financial help may be welcome to sensing that Patricia prefers privacy and wants to handle things herself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia values his concern but is not currently seeking active help; Jose should remain available without prying.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern with a slight uncertainty
temporal_state_chain.intention: Keep the friendship supportive and check in casually without pushing for details.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says she is busy but handling things, thanks Jose for checking in, and tells him his support is great.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change—Jose's belief is confirmed: Patricia is coping, appreciates his supportive presence, and does not need immediate intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is managing her situation and values his support; he can continue supportive check-ins without intruding.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular supportive check-ins and offer help if she asks for it.
